planets.name: TOI-286 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-286 with a 39.4-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-286 c was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-286. Its orbit and size follow Hobson et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
